title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-09
lineage: MR cassette > Nakamichi 550 > Lexicon Alpha > Samplitude > CD-Tag > Flac-16

ai_review.summary: Audience tape captures an epic 49‑minute He's Gone > Truckin' > Playing jam with generally good sound despite occasional fuzz.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience capture from the June 1973 RFK Stadium show, noted for a monster three‑song sequence that many fans describe as “epic.” While most listeners praise the performance and find the tape enjoyable, a few mention noticeable fuzz and limited fidelity. Overall the show shines through the modest tape quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give five‑star praise for the performance (especially the long jam) and rate the tape positively; only one notes sound fuzz, pulling the average down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hand‑held Sony cassette capture from the field; generally clear enough to enjoy the music but exhibits some fuzz and limited low‑end response, especially compared with soundboard recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set opener with Promised Land, followed by a legendary three‑song jam that dominates the show’s reputation; overall pacing praised by attendees.
